_doc: Furniture made by tools/make_furniture.py (kit/props/<id>.glb, outside git). Front = +Z in Godot, base at the origin, centred. Materials by name (wood, wood_dark, stone, metal, water, sack): load with HouseBuilder.skin_prop like any @ prop. size = [x, z, height] in m. pieces = the InteriorBuilder.PIECES ids it can replace ("@<id>").
